title: AWS CodePipeline: AWS CodeBuild vs. AWS CodeCommit vs. AWS CodeDeploy

cues.en: Hello, and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: I hope you're excited, because today, we've got not one but four AWS services.
cues.zh: 希望你期待，今天不是一個，是四個 AWS 服務。

cues.en: We've got CodeCommit, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, and CodePipeline, important and useful services about coding and for developers, so let's dive into it.
cues.zh: CodeCommit、CodeBuild、CodeDeploy、CodePipeline，開發者重要工具，開始。

cues.en: We're gonna start off with CodeCommit.
cues.zh: 先 CodeCommit。

cues.en: It's a service very similar to GitHub, it's a code repository, also uses the Git technology and facilitates developer collaboration.
cues.zh: 很像 GitHub，是 Git 程式碼儲存庫，方便開發者協作。

cues.en: The only main difference is that it lives inside your AWS account, and that's where the developers will be collaborating.
cues.zh: 主要差別是在 AWS 帳戶裡，開發者在那裡協作。

cues.en: The next service is CodeBuild, and basically what happens is once developers commit their code to CodeCommit, that code can be pushed into CodeBuild,
cues.zh: 接著 CodeBuild，程式提交 CodeCommit 後，可送進 CodeBuild，

cues.en: where the source code is compiled, some automated tests are run, and CodeBuild produces ready-to-go software packages.
cues.zh: 編譯、執行自動測試、產生可用軟體套件。

cues.en: Now, if the tests fail and there are some errors, then developers will get the feedback, they work on the code a bit more, and they recommit it to CodeCommit.
cues.zh: 測試失敗或錯誤，開發者收到回饋、修改，再提交。

cues.en: So this whole cycle is called continuous integration and the idea behind it is, and it's quite important to know because the idea behind it is that instead
cues.zh: 這個循環叫持續整合，概念很重要，與其

cues.en: of just working on code for months and months and months and then committing a big chunk of code into CodeCommit or whatever other tool you may be using, this is not just about AWS, this continuous integration,
cues.zh: 寫幾個月才一次提交大塊程式到 CodeCommit 或其他工具，持續整合不限 AWS，

cues.en: instead of doing that, continuous integration encourages developers to post the code or commit the code continuously.
cues.zh: 它鼓勵持續提交。

cues.en: As soon as a little new piece of code is ready, they commit it, it's get tested, it gets corrected, and so on, and this is continuous integration.
cues.zh: 一小段準備好就提交、測試、修正，這就是持續整合。

cues.en: It helps make these little incremental changes to the application.
cues.zh: 讓應用逐步小幅改變。

cues.en: And then from CodeBuild, once the code has passed all tests, it goes to CodeDeploy or can be pushed to CodeDeploy, and CodeDeploy is a deployment automation service.
cues.zh: CodeBuild 通過測試後，可送 CodeDeploy，自動化部署服務。

cues.en: So once you install the CodeDeploy agent to EC2 or some other destination, CodeDeploy can deploy your application or your changes,
cues.zh: 在 EC2 或其他目的地安裝 CodeDeploy agent，就能部署應用或程式修改，

cues.en: the changes of your code to your application.
cues.zh: 將變更套到應用。

cues.en: And CodeDeploy also works with on-premises servers.
cues.zh: 也支援地端伺服器。

cues.en: That's another thing to note for the exam.
cues.zh: 考試要注意。

cues.en: And in general, for the exam, if you're seeing something to do with code repository, developer code collaboration or Git technology, then it's CodeDeploy,
cues.zh: 如果考試說程式庫、開發者協作、Git，這裡講者口述 CodeDeploy；前文明確介紹的是 CodeCommit。

cues.en: something to do with compiling source code, running tests and producing software packages, that would be CodeBuild, and something to do with deployment automation
cues.zh: 編譯原始碼、測試、產生套件，則 CodeBuild；自動化部署，

cues.en: or the Code Deploy agent or working with on-Premises servers, as well as AWS services to deploy code into applications,
cues.zh: CodeDeploy agent、地端與 AWS 服務部署應用，

cues.en: then we CodeDeploy.
cues.zh: 就是 CodeDeploy。

cues.en: There is one more service, as promised, we're going to look at four today, it's called CodePipeline, and CodePipeline is a fully managed
cues.zh: 還有第四個服務，CodePipeline，全受管的

cues.en: CICD pipeline orchestration and automation service.
cues.zh: CI/CD 管線協調與自動化服務。

cues.en: So we've already talked about continuous integration, which is the first part of the diagram.
cues.zh: 已談持續整合，就是圖前半。

cues.en: Well, the last part where the code goes from CodeDeploy to the destination, that's called continuous deployment, or sometimes also continuous delivery,
cues.zh: 最後程式從 CodeDeploy 到目標，叫持續部署，有時也稱持續交付。

cues.en: and altogether, this process in the blue box is called CICD.
cues.zh: 藍框整體叫 CI/CD。

cues.en: And what CodePipeline does is it allows you to orchestrate or automate how this CICD process is going to happen
cues.zh: CodePipeline 協調、自動化整個過程，

cues.en: so that every time a developer adds new code to CodeCommit, then it goes through these steps and gets built, tested, deployed pretty much right away.
cues.zh: 每次開發者加程式到 CodeCommit，就建置、測試、部署，幾乎立刻完成。

cues.en: So whenever on the exam you see something to do with CICD pipeline orchestration or automation or connecting these developer tools together,
cues.zh: 考試見到 CI/CD 管線協調、自動化，或連接開發工具，

cues.en: think about CodePipeline.
cues.zh: 想到 CodePipeline。

cues.en: So there you go. Hope you enjoyed this tutorial.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡。

cues.en: It's pretty cool that we got to talk about all four services in one go.
cues.zh: 一口氣談四種服務，很不錯。

cues.en: And here's a quick summary of what we discussed.
cues.zh: 這裡快速整理。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
